items.title: Why Is Jack Henry (JKHY) Stock Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of financial technology provider Jack Henry & Associates (NASDAQ:JKHY) jumped 7.4% in the afternoon session after It reported a fiscal fourth-quarter earnings beat and fiscal 2027 guidance that cleared the Street. The company reported GAAP diluted EPS of $1.57 versus $1.44 consensus, according to the company press release, even though EPS fell 10.2% from $1.75 a year earlier. items.title: Fintech Jack Henry beats quarterly estimates on strong demand
items.summary: Financial technology firm Jack Henry & Associates beat estimates for fourth-quarter profit ‌and revenue on Tuesday, thanks to strong ‌demand for its banking and payments offerings. Shares of the company ​rose 1.9% in extended trading after the results.
